versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-kuaishou-data-harvester.

- Enables one-click collection and structured export of Kuaishou public data: search by keyword, fetch creator posts, and extract video comments.
- Supports use cases such as topic research, competitor monitoring, and sentiment analysis.
- Offers safe, login-free access, batch processing (up to 10,000 items), and flexible filtering/export.
- Outputs unified structured JSON results, designed for integration with marketing and content workflows.
- Requires a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN; see official site for access and support.
